_note: My Fair Mahjong The Style of Your Life Series (Pearl Green) album, Claude's round-1 picks (Nov 7, run like Juniper; Tiffany Nov 7 7:03pm 'My Fair Mahjong next'). DRAFT order until she says it's final. Juniper overlap kept at the bottom under 'Also in Juniper', hers to keep or cut. Pair mat Parquet Petal sits in the group, never #1.

mats.name: Tennis Club
mats.why: Every one of her face colors in one mat: navy stripes like her indigo ink, a bubblegum pink frame, kelly gingham to hold the pearl green backs, and a powder blue plaid like her cornflower earrings.

mats.name: MOD Daisies
mats.why: Her faces turned into flowers: cornflower, bubblegum pink and red daisies with marigold centers, on a green ground that makes the backs glow.

mats.name: Crimson Harvest
mats.why: Wine pomegranates and pink roses on deep green: her wine handbags, her pink, and the darkest green in her backs. The moody one, and it carries her from Thanksgiving to Christmas.

mats.name: Floral Instincts
mats.why: Pink leopard on navy inside a green frame. A set about handbags and shoes deserves a little leopard.

mats.name: Peacock Circle
mats.why: Cobalt ground and green peacock feathers: just her indigo and her greens, so the white faces pop.

mats.name: Peach Petals
mats.why: Navy and hot pink stripes around pink and green petals: pink, navy and green, all turned up.

mats.name: Parquet Petal
mats.why: My Fair Mahjong made Parquet Petal for this set: its border print is on her tile bag and box. The pink center is lovely with her faces, but there's no green in it, so it sits here, not at #1. Still listed as coming soon on their site.

mats.name: Merrye (Pink and Blue)
mats.why: Pink, cornflower and kelly green in a kaleidoscope of cranes and blossoms.

mats.name: Preppy Palms
mats.why: Tennis Club's sister: the same gingham and navy stripes, with a solid navy center and palm fronds.

mats.name: Grandmillennial Peony
mats.why: Coral-pink peonies around a deep navy center. Polished, a little grown-up, with her indigo underneath.

mats.name: Haven
mats.why: Painterly pink and violet peonies on deep navy.

mats.name: Color Wave – Cobalt Center
mats.why: Her two blues as solid color: a cobalt center with a light blue scallop, so the green backs and white faces do the talking.

mats.name: Birdie Green
mats.why: Kelly green with cobalt peacocks and a touch of pink: green, indigo and pink.

mats.name: SoHo
mats.why: Navy and blue art deco with a green edge.

mats.name: Pink and Green Gator Skin
mats.why: A croc handbag as a mat: bubblegum pink scales on kelly green, right at home with her handbag craks.

mats.name: Pink Peonies
mats.why: Pink peonies in a blue-and-white vase: pink, cornflower and green leaves.

mats.name: The Polo Club
mats.why: A navy center inside green tartan: her indigo and deep green, and it works for the holidays too.

mats.name: Deep Green Garden Party
mats.why: Blue and lavender hydrangeas on deep green.

mats.name: Legacy
mats.why: A leopard and pink roses on forest green, with a pink border.

mats.name: Green Malachite
mats.why: The stone her backs are made to look like, so it's tone on tone. It's also in Juniper's album.

mats.name: Garden Glow – Emerald Green
mats.why: Blue, violet and marigold wildflowers on deep green suit her faces even better than Juniper's, but it's Juniper's #2.

mats.name: Cheetah in Chinoiserie
mats.why: Navy sky, pink blossoms and a bamboo frame. Also in Juniper's album.

out.Pink, Blue + Green (Amahj): Claude, Nov 7: dropped before review. Only photo is an angled shot on white, and it reads pink + green only.
